2026-10-20.heading: Saint of the Day
2026-10-20.name: Saint Shallita (Artemius)
2026-10-20.story: Shallita, also known as Artemius, was born in the fourth century. A high-ranking Roman army officer, he was given responsibility for the troops stationed in Egypt and remained a faithful Christian despite the danger to his position and his life. Summoned before the emperor in Antioch for destroying pagan temples and idols, he is held in great veneration. Many churches and monasteries in Lebanon bear his name, and he is considered the patron of animals.

2026-10-21.heading: Saint of the Day
2026-10-21.name: Saint Hilarion
2026-10-21.story: Hilarion was born in Palestine to a pagan family and studied in Alexandria, where he became a Christian. Through Saint Anthony the Abbot he learned to love contemplative solitude, prayer and penance. He withdrew as a hermit to Maiumma, where he founded several monasteries and brought about conversions. He died in Paphos.

2026-10-22.heading: Saint of the Day
2026-10-22.name: Saint John Paul II
2026-10-22.story: Karol Wojtyła, born in 1920 in Wadowice, Poland, lost his mother at nine and his brother at twelve. During the German occupation he worked in a stone quarry and a chemical plant, then was ordained a priest in 1946. Elected pope in 1978, he cried out at his inaugural Mass on October 22: “Do not be afraid! Open wide the doors to Christ!” He died on April 2, 2005, was beatified in 2011 and declared a saint in 2014.
